item.title: Version 3.0 (397)
item.description:
New in this version:

Output menu: play Echo on Bluetooth, USB or HDMI speakers (just Echo, not the whole Mac), or pick AirPlay, all from one button
When another app plays (a video, a call): lower Echo's volume, pause it, or do nothing (Settings › Playback)
Fancier lyrics: bigger text, the active line pops and stays in the middle
Library: Jump to Song setting, star / heart toggle on hover, one source at a time
Wider Settings, compact player closes the library, floating player starts with the library open
Requires macOS 15 Sequoia or later

item.title: Version 3.0 (362)
item.description:
Settings and library improvements.

- Check for Updates toggle with Daily / Weekly / Monthly in Settings
- Sync ★ setting with a short explanation
- Click the song count for Resync Library and Switch Media Source

item.title: Version 3.0 (357)
item.description:
Fixes Echo 3.0 (352) not starting: it couldn't load its update framework.

If you installed 352 and Echo won't open, download this version from the Updates page.

item.title: Version 3.0 (352)
item.description:
First release with automatic updates.

- Compact player, AppKit menu bar with a native menu
- ★ favourites sync with the Music app, including background sync
- Crossfade and EQ over AirPlay (experimental), memory fix for AirPlay streaming
- Separate Mac and AirPlay volumes, playlist-scoped shuffle
